simple.meaning: properly, pallor , i.e. hence, the yellowish green of young and sickly vegetation; concretely, verdure , i.e. grass or vegetation
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to יֶרֶק (H3418) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

definitions.short: properly, pallor , i.e. hence, the yellowish green of young and sickly vegetation; concretely, verdure , i.e. grass or vegetation
definitions.full: H3418. yereq יֶ֫רֶק noun masculine Isa 15:6 green, greenness (on in gardens, see Nö ZMG 1876, 777 Löw p. 236 f. ) — absolute Exod 10:15 ; Isa 15:6 ; construct Gen 1:30 3 t.; — עֵשֶׂב יֶרֶק 1:30 ; 9:3 (both P); דֶּשֶׁא יֶרֶק Psa 37:2 הַשָּׂדֶה יֶרֶק Num 22:4 (E) = green thing, grass ; alone Exod 10:15 (J) green thing , including עֵץ and עֵשֶׂב , Isa 15:6 .
definitions.rootNote: from 3417 (in the sense of vacuity of color);
